In accordance with the terms of the Arrangement Agreement, the Consideration remained at $0.43 per Share based on the estimated working capital of the Company (as calculated in accordance with the Arrangement Agreement, which excludes certain indebtedness and closing costs) as of the effective date of the Transaction (the "

The annual and special meeting of Shareholders and holders of options to purchase Shares (collectively, "

Greenhouse Appraisals
The Company also announces that appraisals (the "
Appraisals
") previously prepared by an independent real estate appraisal firm in respect of each of the Company's three greenhouse farm properties (the "
Properties

") have been made available to Securityholders. The Appraisals were prepared in July 2026 in connection with negotiations with the Company's lenders and possible refinancing of the mortgages on the Properties. Securityholders can access the Appraisals under the Company's profile on SEDAR+ and may also request a copy of the Appraisals to be sent without charge by contacting Enrico (Rick) Paolone, Interim Chief Executive Officer and Board Chair of the Company, at rpaolone@greenrisefoods.ca or 416.669.1550.

The Appraisals appraised the Properties with the following market values as at the dates of such Appraisals (as defined in the Appraisals and subject to certain assumptions and conditions set out therein): (i) $52,997,000 estimated market value for the greenhouse property located at 2633 Albuna Townline, Town of Kingsville, ON ("
GR1

"), (ii) $19,843,000 estimated market value for the greenhouse property located at 1921 Road 3 East, Town of Kingsville, ON, and (iii) $17,700,000 estimated market value for the greenhouse property located at 795 Road 4 East, Town of Kingsville, ON. The Appraisals were prepared by an independent real estate appraisal firm in accordance with the Canadian Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice.
As disclosed in the Circular, the special committee of independent directors of the Company (the "
Special Committee

") compared the Appraisals to offers received for the individual Properties pursuant to the Company's strategic review process and determined that in order to derive any per-Share indication of value from the Appraisals, a series of significant adjustments and assumptions would have to be made, including:

the Appraisals do not reflect the value of the Properties as held and operated, especially in respect of GR1 which Appraisal does not account for the restrictive covenants that run with the property, the operating restrictions and shared infrastructure with Mastronardi Produce Limited, the Transaction ROFR (as defined in the Circular) nor potentially less replacement cost for new double poly greenhouse capacity;

the appraised values do not take into account the mortgages and other indebtedness secured on the Properties and the liquidity implication of such debt in light of negotiations with the Company's lenders;
any realization of the appraised values would require a sale of the Properties and would trigger recapture and capital gains tax on disposition; and
there would be further significant dividend "tax leakage" in distributing the net proceeds of the disposition of individual Properties to Shareholders.

In light of the foregoing and the offers received for the individual Properties, and considering the advice of Blair Franklin Capital Partners Inc., financial advisor to the Special Committee, as to the fairness, from a financial point of view, of the Consideration to be received by Shareholders (other than the Excluded Securityholders) pursuant to the Transaction, the Special Committee was of the view that the Appraisals should not reasonably affect the decision of Securityholders in evaluating the Transaction.
About the Company

Green Rise uses its wholly-owned 89 acres of Controlled-Environment Agriculture Greenhouses to produce high-quality fresh produce under the "SUNSET" brand for Mastronardi Produce Ltd, our distribution partner. Green Rise is proud to be an environmentally sustainable investment providing bee-pollinated, high-quality fresh products to meet the growing consumer demand for locally grown fresh produce.
